publication.title: Great apes track hidden objects after changes in the objects' position and in subject's orientation

dataset.name: EVApeCognition Dataset
license_evidence: Scientific Data descriptor states the dataset is CC-BY 4.0
dataset.rights_boundary: Do not ingest or redistribute data beyond the declared dataset release. The dataset paper states that original contributing authors remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of contributed data.

snapshot_verification.verification_method: fetched exact study YAML, data CSV, glossary CSV, domain definitions, and README at Git ref v1.0.4; every returned blob SHA matched the manifest

dataset.doi_resolution_note: 10.5281/zenodo.18846348 is the concept DOI that resolves to the latest release; 10.5281/zenodo.18849382 is the exact dataset DOI cited in reference 193 of the Scientific Data article and indexed by the NLM Dataset Catalog. The GitHub v1.0.4 tag was independently checked against all source artifact blob SHAs.

source_artifacts.role: study metadata, abstract, task taxonomy and experiment scope
standardized trial-level source data; not copied into this research artifact

data_minimization.subject_linkage: Use an internal stable pseudonymous token only for repeated-measures grouping and subject-held-out split construction. Do not export the token-to-name mapping.
data_minimization.demographics: Age and sex are excluded from the initial pilot; species may be retained as a coarse source descriptor but not used to rank species.

evaluation_boundary.split_policy: leave-one-subject-out; all trials from a subject remain in the same fold

limitations: This is one study and one spatial/object-tracking task.
The standardized source contains repeated trials within subjects.
Only 150 of 246 publications in the EVApeCognition source-literature pool were standardized at the time reported in the 2026 descriptor.
The source authors disclaim responsibility for the accuracy/completeness of contributing original datasets.
The exact immutable Zenodo version DOI must be resolved before a benchmark release.
